commentary: A classic split-market tape demands strict defensive posture. While benchmark indices rallied sharply on heavyweight strength, market breadth diverged negatively with a breadth score of 41 and the gate rated WEAK. William O'Neil repeatedly cautioned against trusting index rebounds when mid- and small-cap participation stalls, as divergence typically signals distribution beneath the surface. Stan Weinstein's stage analysis mandates buying only verified Stage 2 leaders emerging from sound bases above rising 30-week moving averages. With broad tape conditions fragile, progressive exposure dictates holding elevated cash reserves, ignoring extended setups, and capping exposure until institutional accumulation broadens beyond index heavyweights.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Constructing a double-bottom base above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA on 3.63x volume expansion with RSI at 62. However, overhead supply from historical distribution caps relative strength.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite massive top-line expansion to ₹137 Cr, core operations deteriorated into an operating loss of ₹71.7 Cr and net loss of ₹47.6 Cr. Low 3-year ROE (1.0%) violates CANSLIM fundamental criteria.
63MOONS.risk: Thesis invalidates if price slips below base support stop at ₹874.42; exit immediately to preserve capital.

ABDL.technical: Forming a double bottom above key moving averages with RSI 66. Relative strength remains mediocre following its recent IPO base, with volume at a modest 1.29x average.
ABDL.fundamental: Top-line growth of 1.9% YoY to ₹1,809 Cr and falling net profit highlight persistent margin pressure. P/E above 90 lacks the CANSLIM 25%+ earnings catalyst required for institutional support.
ABDL.risk: Pattern breaks down if the ₹689.11 swing stop is breached; honor stop immediately without averaging down.

ADVANCE.technical: Textbook Stage 2 Darvas-style 20-day high breakout on an extraordinary 41.4x volume burst. Price is aligned above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with strong MACD momentum.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM profile with Q1 profit surging 152% YoY to ₹22.6 Cr on 96% sales growth to ₹330 Cr. Backed by an impressive 19.6% ROCE and a clean balance sheet.
ADVANCE.risk: Thesis fails if price slips back below breakout support stop at ₹125.05; do not chase above pivot.

AEROENTER.technical: Carving out a double bottom above moving averages with RSI at 61, but lacks conviction. Volume expansion is absent and relative strength lags broader market leaders significantly.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Core operational deterioration as Q1 sales fell 4.9% YoY and net profit sank 97% to ₹0.08 Cr amid severe EBITDA margin contraction to 5.7%. Fails basic CANSLIM profitability screens.
AEROENTER.risk: A breakdown below ₹146.32 violates base structure; enforce strict loss discipline and cut position.

ALLDIGI.technical: Clean 20-day breakout supported by an institutional 10.5x volume expansion. Moving averages are in sequential bullish alignment with positive MACD momentum and strong relative strength.
ALLDIGI.fundamental: Strong operating margins (~30%), 27.9% ROCE, zero debt, and healthy 36% profit growth demonstrate business quality. However, modest 5.7% top-line growth limits full CANSLIM qualification.
ALLDIGI.risk: Breakout fails if price retreats below the ₹848 stop level; cut losses quickly to preserve capital.

ANGELONE.technical: Tight consolidation within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot, maintaining constructive support above 21 EMA and 50 SMA. Volume is 1.4x average with neutral-to-constructive RSI at 58.
ANGELONE.fundamental: Solid franchise metrics with Q2 consolidated revenue expanding 25.4% YoY and net profit rising 58% to ₹335 Cr. ROE of 15.6% and robust cash flow support high earnings quality.
ANGELONE.risk: Decelerating earnings trend caps setup; breakdown below ₹310.37 stop invalidates consolidation thesis.
